prompt: Review llm_eval/runner.py in llm-eval, blind, for resume and grading defects. For each finding give the function and the failure it causes. Report only; no edits.

solution.answer:
Resume does not bind to the original plan hash, so a different plan can be resumed.
Resuming before smoke never loads the scratch server, so smoke runs with no server.
Smoke grades 'ok' in reply as a substring, so 'book a table' passes.

followups.default: I won't be answering questions on this one; finish with your answer and change nothing.
